note: Ottawa NF campground on 317-acre Marion Lake, 4 mi E of Watersmeet via US 2, FR 3980 and FR 3985 (Watersmeet/Iron River RD); three loops with sites screened by natural vegetation. Adjacent sandy beach and day-use area (picnic tables, grills, play area); free concrete boat ramps east of loop 2 and west of loop 1. Walleye, smallmouth bass, northern pike and perch. A group site for up to 100 sits beside the loops. --Claude
